title: Group Project: Process, Scrum and Microservices
lead: Covers the 7-week cross-functional microservices project: the two cases (Apartment Management, University Services), team allocation and roles, mandatory technology and architecture requirements, governance, Jira / Scrum / GitHub rules, Definition of Ready and Done, deliverables and templates, assessment rubric and the demonstration checklist. Includes a short background on process models. No prior attendance needed.
